title: RodrigueAI/lexcare-ai
summary: RodrigueAI/lexcare-ai 是一个基于 FastAPI、LangChain 和向量数据库的检索增强生成平台，用于处理医疗法规、政策文件和监管更新。该平台利用先进的算法和架构，提供高效的文档检索和生成服务，适用于医疗行业的信息处理和分析。
description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform for healthcare legislation, policy documents, and regulatory updates using FastAPI, LangChain, and vector databases.Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform for healthcare legislation, policy documents, and regulatory updates using FastAPI, LangChai
